metadata.name: bordrless_launch
metadata.description: The Bordrless launchpad: creates a Bordrless Token Standard token with the rules it fixes at launch (installing the kit as its token hook when it has any) and its curve pool on the Bordrless DEX, runs the sniper fee, the creator fee, the holder fee and the burn as the pool's hook, graduates the pool with locked liquidity and pays creators.

docs: Instructions of the launchpad.

instructions.name: after_swap
docs: Pool hook: a buy's burn; a sell's creator and holder fees (and its custom hook's SOL cut),
from the output the DEX hands on.

accounts.name: launch
docs: The launch of the base mint. Only `create_launch` creates a `Launch`, at
`["launch", mint]` with that mint, so the owner, the discriminator and the mint bind it
without a derivation.

accounts.name: holder_vault
docs: writable holding of the quote before paying it).

accounts.name: kit_config
docs: rewards are on.

instructions.name: before_initialize
docs: Pool hook: refuses pools with this hook that this program did not create.

instructions.name: before_swap
docs: Pool hook: the anti-sniper LP fee; a buy's creator and holder fees (and its custom hook's
SOL cut), a sell's burn. A buy past the end of the curve is filled: the answer, set as the
return data (`bordrless_hook::set_answer`), ends with the part of the input the swap uses.

accounts.name: launch
docs: The launch of the base mint. Only `create_launch` creates a `Launch`, at
`["launch", mint]` with that mint, so the owner, the discriminator and the mint bind it
without a derivation.

accounts.name: holder_vault
docs: writable holding of the quote before paying it).

accounts.name: kit_config
docs: rewards are on.

instructions.name: claim_author_fees
docs: A listed config's author takes their share of a launch's creator fees; the creator's part
is paid at the same time, as on the creator's own claim.

accounts.name: author
docs: The config's author.

accounts.name: launch_config
docs: The listed config the launch was made from.

instructions.name: claim_author_fees_sol
docs: `claim_author_fees` for a native launch, in SOL.

instructions.name: claim_creator_fees
docs: The creator takes the creator fees collected so far.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The creator.

instructions.name: claim_creator_fees_sol
docs: `claim_creator_fees` for a native launch: its creator fees paid in SOL from the launch
account to the creator's wallet (and the author's and the partner's parts to theirs).

instructions.name: create_config
docs: Anyone: makes a `LaunchConfig` (rules, creator fee, optionally a custom token hook),
fixed once created, for launches to use by its key.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Whoever makes the config: pays the rent.

accounts.name: config
docs: The launch config, for the bounds.

accounts.name: launch_config

accounts.name: hook_program
docs: program's id for none); checked executable in the handler.

instructions.name: create_launch
docs: Creates a token and its curve pool, from the inline rules or from a `LaunchConfig`. With
a custom hook, the remaining accounts are the hook, the token program's signer for it,
its registry for the mint and the registry's extras.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The creator: pays the launch fee and the rent.

accounts.name: launch_reserve
docs: address).

accounts.name: registry
docs: when written).

accounts.name: pool
docs: this program as hook).

docs: pool's creation takes as its hook signer.

docs: token instructions of a kit mint take as their hook signer; unused without a kit.

accounts.name: kit_program
docs: program's id stands for an absent one; the kit accounts below likewise). Checked in the
handler.

accounts.name: kit_registry

accounts.name: reward_vault

accounts.name: launch_config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch is made from, when it is (this program's id for none): the
rules, the creator fee and the custom hook come from it, and the arguments must match.

instructions.name: create_listed_config
docs: Anyone: makes a `LaunchConfig` for the marketplace: as `create_config`, plus the author's
share of the creator fee (1 to 5,000 basis points of it) on every launch someone else makes
from it, fixed for ever.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Whoever makes the config: pays the rent.

accounts.name: config
docs: The launch config, for the bounds.

accounts.name: launch_config
docs: The new config: a keypair that signs.

accounts.name: hook_program
docs: program's id for none); checked executable in the handler.

instructions.name: create_partner_config
docs: Anyone: makes a `LaunchConfig` with a partner (`docs/partner-fee.md`), Meteora-style: every
launch made from it, whoever makes it, pays `partner` `partner_share_bps` of its creator fee
(1 to 10,000 basis points of it), as SOL to the partner's holding, on every claim. It may
also carry an author's share (`author_share_bps`, 0 to 5,000; at most 10,000 with the
partner's) and a custom hook's SOL cut (`cut`, zeros for none). Fixed for ever.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Whoever makes the config (its author): pays the rent of both accounts.

accounts.name: config
docs: The launch config, for the bounds.

accounts.name: launch_config
docs: The new config: a keypair that signs.

accounts.name: partner_fee
docs: The config's partner, made with it.

accounts.name: hook_program
docs: program's id for none); checked executable in the handler.

instructions.name: create_quote_cut_config
docs: Anyone: makes a `LaunchConfig` whose custom hook also takes a SOL cut on every trade
(`docs/quote-cut.md`): the hook's `quote_cut` answers a rate, the pool hook takes at most
`cut`'s cap (at most 1,000 basis points a side) of the trade's SOL with the creator fee.
`author_share_bps` 0: as `create_config`; else as `create_listed_config`.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Whoever makes the config: pays the rent.

accounts.name: config
docs: The launch config, for the bounds.

accounts.name: launch_config
docs: The new config: a keypair that signs.

accounts.name: hook_program
docs: program's id for none); checked executable in the handler.

instructions.name: distribute_fees
docs: Anyone: pays out the creator fees of a launch made from a partner config
(`docs/partner-fee.md`), every party at once (the partner, the config's author when the
launch pays one, the creator), each to its own fixed holding of the quote.

accounts.name: partner_fee
docs: The partner of the config the launch was made from.

instructions.name: distribute_fees_sol
docs: `distribute_fees` for a native launch, in SOL.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: Graduates a launch whose pool has raised the threshold. Permissionless. With a custom
hook, the remaining accounts are the hook, the token program's signer for it and the
registry's extras.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever cranks it; pays only the network fee.

accounts.name: launch
docs: The launch (only `create_launch` creates one, at its PDA).

accounts.name: token_hook_signer
docs: reserve's transfer and burn take as their hook signer; unused without a kit.

accounts.name: kit_program
docs: (this program's id) otherwise, as are the kit accounts below. Checked in the handler.

accounts.name: reward_vault
docs: extras on the reserve's transfer and burn).

accounts.name: kit_caller
docs: kit's `graduate`.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Creates the config; signed by the program's upgrade authority, once.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The upgrade authority, paying the rent.

instructions.name: migrate_launch_to_native
docs: Admin, with the DEX paused and the launch's pool native: turns a launch native (its
creator fees and its kit's rewards to lamports). Idempotent.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin; a plain wallet (it wraps the launch's lamports on the way back, credited them
first, so it ends where it started).

accounts.name: kit_program
docs: the kit accounts below.

instructions.name: revert_launch_to_bridged
docs: Admin, with the DEX paused: turns a native launch back to bridged SOL. Idempotent.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin; a plain wallet (it wraps the launch's lamports on the way back, credited them
first, so it ends where it started).

accounts.name: kit_program
docs: the kit accounts below.

instructions.name: set_config
docs: Admin: changes the config. Launches keep the terms they were created with.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin.

instructions.name: set_native_launches
docs: Admin: whether launches made from now on are native.

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: math overflow

errors.name: HolderFeeTooHigh
errors.msg: a holder fee is above the maximum

errors.name: BurnTooHigh
errors.msg: a burn is above the maximum

errors.name: RulesFeeTooHigh
errors.msg: creator fee, holder fee and burn add up to more than the maximum on one side

errors.name: MaxWalletOutOfBounds
errors.msg: max wallet must be off or within the bounds

errors.name: CreatorLockTooLong
errors.msg: the creator wallet lock is longer than the maximum

errors.name: InvalidEarlyLock
errors.msg: the early-buyer lock needs a window within the maximum and an unlock after it, within the maximum

errors.name: KitAccountsMissing
errors.msg: a launch with kit rules needs the kit's accounts

errors.name: UnexpectedKitAccounts
errors.msg: a kit account was passed for a launch without that rule

errors.name: WrongKitAccount
errors.msg: a kit account is not at its address

errors.name: WrongHolderVault
errors.msg: the holder vault passed is not the launch's

errors.name: CustomHookWithKitRules
errors.msg: a config with a custom hook can have no kit rule (holder rewards, max wallet, the locks)

errors.name: InvalidCustomHook
errors.msg: the custom hook must be an executable program that is none of the protocol's

errors.name: InvalidCustomHookFlags
errors.msg: the custom hook's flags must name at least one callback and no unknown bit

errors.name: HookRegistryMissing
errors.msg: the custom hook has no registry for this mint: prepare the hook for the mint first

errors.name: HookExtrasMismatch
errors.msg: the custom hook's extra accounts do not match its registry

errors.name: CustomHookAccountsMissing
errors.msg: a launch with a custom hook needs the hook's accounts

errors.name: UnexpectedCustomHookAccounts
errors.msg: custom hook accounts were passed for a launch without one

errors.name: ConfigMismatch
errors.msg: the arguments do not match the launch config

errors.name: WrongHookSigner
errors.msg: the hook signer passed is not the token program's signer for the custom hook

errors.name: InvalidLabel
errors.msg: the label is longer than 32 bytes

errors.name: InvalidAuthorShare
errors.msg: a listed config's author share is between 1 and 5,000 basis points of the creator fee

errors.name: NoAuthorShare
errors.msg: this launch pays no config author

errors.name: AuthorAccountsMissing
errors.msg: a launch that pays its config's author needs the config and the author's holding

errors.name: NotAuthor
errors.msg: the signer is not the config's author

errors.name: HookUpgradeable
errors.msg: the custom hook can be upgraded by someone other than Bordrless: make it immutable or deploy it with Studio

errors.name: HookProgramDataMissing
errors.msg: the custom hook's program data account is missing or wrong

errors.name: HookTimelockInvalid
errors.msg: the custom hook's upgrade authority is its timelock: pass its Timelock account (owned by hook_timelock, for this program, a delay of at least 3 days)

errors.name: HookTimelockPending
errors.msg: the custom hook's timelock holds a proposal of new code: a coin is made on a timelocked hook only while nothing is pending (its author cancels it, or it lands first)

errors.name: InvalidQuoteCut
errors.msg: a SOL cut needs the config's custom hook and at most 1,000 basis points on each side, buys above 0 (the hook is always asked on buys; it may answer 0)

errors.name: QuoteCutAccountsMissing
errors.msg: this coin's hook takes a SOL cut: pass the hook program, the trader's holding of the token, the hook's state and the launchpad's signer for the hook after the pool's four extras (the pool's registry lists them)

errors.name: QuoteCutWrongAccount
errors.msg: a SOL cut account is not the one this trade needs (the custom hook, the trader's holding of the token, the hook's writable [\state\, mint], the launchpad's [\quote-cut\, hook])

errors.name: QuoteCutBadAnswer
errors.msg: the hook's quote_cut answered something other than its cut in basis points (a u16)

errors.name: InvalidPartnerShare
errors.msg: a partner's share is 1 to 10,000 basis points of the creator fee, and with the author's share at most 10,000 in all

errors.name: InvalidPartner
errors.msg: the partner is the default key

errors.name: PartnerAccountsMissing
errors.msg: a launch that pays a partner needs the partner's account (writable [\partner\, config]) and the partner's holding of the quote, after any author accounts

errors.name: NoPartnerShare
errors.msg: this launch pays no partner

errors.name: PartnerOnCompanion
errors.msg: a companion coin can't launch from a partner config: its creator fees are the companion's to split (share them with payees instead)

errors.name: NotNativeLaunch
errors.msg: this launch is not native: its fees are claimed in bridged SOL

errors.name: DexNotPaused
errors.msg: the DEX must be paused for this

errors.name: PoolNotNative
errors.msg: the launch's pool is not native yet: migrate the pool first

errors.name: RecipientBelowRent
errors.msg: a recipient would be left below the rent-exempt minimum

errors.name: CompanionLaunch
errors.msg: a companion coin stays on bridged SOL until its companion is paid in SOL

docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Buys from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: creator_bought
docs: The creator's own first buy took the normal LP fee inside the sniper window (once).

fields.name: holder_fees_accrued
docs: Holder fees taken so far (bridged SOL, into the holder vault).

fields.name: burned_on_trades
docs: Tokens burned on trades (both sides; not the graduation burn).

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch was made from; the default key for inline rules.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook (from the config), when the token has one. It runs on every
transfer, mint and burn its flags name; nobody vets its code.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The custom hook's flags; 0 without one.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: The config author's share of the creator fee (basis points of it), from a listed config
whose author is not the launch's creator; 0 otherwise. Fixed at launch: every claim pays
the author this part of what it takes.

fields.name: author_fees_paid
docs: Creator fees paid to the config's author so far (quote).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved. `reserved[0..4]` are the custom hook's SOL cut caps from the config
([`Launch::quote_cut`]), `reserved[4..12]` the SOL it has taken so far (part of
`creator_fees_accrued`), `reserved[12]` the bump of the hook's `["state", mint]` and
`reserved[13]` of the launchpad's `["quote-cut", hook]` signer; zeros for every launch made
before (`docs/quote-cut.md`). `reserved[14..16]` are the partner's share of the creator fee
and `reserved[16]` the bump of the config's [`PartnerFee`], from the config
([`Launch::partner_share_bps`], `docs/partner-fee.md`); zeros for every launch made before.

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: A launch config (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.7): the rules, the creator fee and, for a
build-your-own token, the creator's own token hook, made with the SDK by anyone as a keypair
account (so its key can be shared and pasted), fixed once created and usable for any number of
launches. `create_launch` takes one as an optional account; without one the rules come inline.
A config can never touch the protocol's share.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who made it.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules (within the launch config's bounds when made, checked again at launch).

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee on every swap, in basis points of the quote.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook program (§5.8), when the config is for a build-your-own
token; then no kit module may be on (one token hook per mint). The mint is created with it
and no hook authority.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The hook's flags (`bordrless_hook::token_flags`); 0 without a custom hook.

fields.name: label
docs: A short name, for the site.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: A listed config's author share (`create_listed_config`): the part of the creator fee, in
basis points of it (at most `MAX_AUTHOR_SHARE_BPS`), paid to `creator` (the config's
author) on every launch made from it by someone else. Fixed at creation; 0 for a config
made with `create_config`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved. `reserved[0]` is [`LaunchConfig::TIMELOCKED_HOOK`] when the custom hook's upgrade
authority was its own `hook_timelock` when the config was made (phase 3a); 0 for every other
config, and for every config made before. `reserved[1..5]` are the SOL cut's caps
([`LaunchConfig::quote_cut`], `docs/quote-cut.md`), 0 for every config made before.
`reserved[5..7]` are the partner's share and `reserved[7]` the bump of its [`PartnerFee`]
([`LaunchConfig::partner_share_bps`], `docs/partner-fee.md`), 0 for every config made before.

types.name: LaunchConfigCreated

fields.name: rules

fields.name: kit_config

fields.name: holder_vault
docs: Where holder fees go (the kit's reward vault) when holder rewards are on.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Buys from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch was made from, when it was.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook, when the token has one.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: Its flags; 0 without one.

types.name: LaunchNativeSet
docs: A launch moved between bridged SOL and native SOL: its creator fees (`moved`, unwrapped onto
the launch or wrapped back into its holding) and its kit's reward vault with it.

types.name: LaunchPartner
docs: A launch made from a partner config, after its `LaunchCreated`: every claim of its creator fees
pays the config's partner `partner_share_bps` of what it takes.

types.name: LaunchQuoteCut
docs: A launch made from such a config: its pool asks the hook on every trade.

types.name: LaunchRules
docs: The rules a launch fixes for its token (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.1): what the pool hook takes on
each side, and the kit modules the token gets. Holder rewards are on when either holder fee is
above 0.

fields.name: holder_fee_buy_bps
docs: Holder fee on buys, from the quote input, paid to the holder vault.

fields.name: holder_fee_sell_bps
docs: Holder fee on sells, from the quote output after the protocol fee.

fields.name: burn_buy_bps
docs: Burn on buys, from the token output.

fields.name: burn_sell_bps
docs: Burn on sells, from the token input.

fields.name: max_wallet_bps
docs: Max wallet in basis points of the supply; 0 = off. Lifts at graduation.

fields.name: creator_lock_secs
docs: Creator wallet lock, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_window_secs
docs: Early-buyer window, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_lock_secs
docs: Early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch; above `early_window_secs` (0 when the lock is
off).

types.name: NativeLaunchesSet
docs: The admin turned native launches on or off for launches made from now on.

types.name: PartnerConfigured
docs: A partner config (`create_partner_config`, `docs/partner-fee.md`), after its
`LaunchConfigCreated` (and `ConfigListed` / `QuoteCutConfigured` when it has those too): every
launch from it pays `partner` `partner_share_bps` of the creator fee.

types.name: PartnerFee
docs: A partner config's partner (`create_partner_config`, `docs/partner-fee.md`), at
`["partner", launch_config]`: the wallet paid `share_bps` of the creator fee of every launch
made from the config, whoever launches, as the author's share is paid. Made with the config,
in the same instruction, and never changed: only its running total moves.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump.

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` it belongs to.

fields.name: partner
docs: Who is paid: its holding of the quote receives the partner's part of each claim.

fields.name: share_bps
docs: The partner's share of the creator fee, in basis points of it (1 to 10,000).

fields.name: paid_total
docs: What the partner has been paid so far, from every launch made from the config (quote).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: PartnerFeesPaid
docs: A partner's part of a claim of creator fees (whoever claimed). `paid_total` counts every launch
made from the config.

types.name: Phase
docs: Before or after the operation.

types.name: PoolHookArgs
docs: Arguments of a pool hook callback.

fields.name: op
docs: The operation.

fields.name: phase
docs: Before or after it.

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: Base mint.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Quote mint.

fields.name: actor
docs: The trader or liquidity provider.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Who receives: for a swap the owner of the holding the output is delivered to; for liquidity
the owner of the receiving holding (the LP holding on add, the base holding on remove); the
default key on initialize.

fields.name: direction
docs: Swap direction: 0 base → quote (a sell), 1 quote → base (a buy).

fields.name: amount_in
docs: Swap input (after any before-delta, before fees); liquidity base amount.

fields.name: amount_out
docs: Swap output (known after); liquidity quote amount.

fields.name: base_reserve
docs: Real base reserve.

fields.name: quote_reserve
docs: Real quote reserve.

fields.name: virtual_base
docs: Virtual base offset.

fields.name: virtual_quote
docs: Virtual quote offset.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: The pool's LP fee (after a swap: the fee actually applied).

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: The pool's protocol fee.

fields.name: swap_count
docs: Swaps so far (before this one).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Pool creation time.

fields.name: lp_amount
docs: LP amount of a liquidity operation.

fields.name: hook_data
docs: Opaque data from the caller (v4's `hookData`).

types.name: PoolOp
docs: What a pool hook is being told about.

types.name: QuoteCut
docs: A custom hook's SOL cut (`docs/quote-cut.md`): on every trade the pool hook asks the hook's
`quote_cut` for a rate in basis points, takes at most these caps of the trade's SOL (a buy's
input, a sell's output) and adds it to the creator fee. Kept in reserved bytes, little-endian,
so every account made before reads zeros: off.

fields.name: max_buy_bps
docs: The most the hook may take of a buy's SOL input, in basis points.

fields.name: max_sell_bps
docs: The most the hook may take of a sell's SOL output, in basis points.

types.name: QuoteCutConfigured
docs: A `LaunchConfig` whose custom hook takes a SOL cut on every trade, decided by the hook's
`quote_cut` (`docs/quote-cut.md`), at most these caps per side.

types.name: QuoteCutTaken
docs: A trade paid a hook's SOL cut (logged by the pool hook, not by self-CPI: the DEX's callback
has no event authority). It goes to the launch's quote holding with the creator fee.

fields.name: direction
docs: 0 a sell, 1 a buy.

fields.name: answered_bps
docs: What the hook answered (before the cap) and the rate taken.

fields.name: amount
docs: Lamports of bridged SOL.

types.name: RuleBounds
docs: The bounds `create_launch` holds token rules to (§5.2), kept in the [`Config`]. `init_config`
and `set_config` keep each within the hard ceilings of [`crate::constants::ceilings`].

fields.name: max_holder_fee_bps
docs: Largest holder fee per side.

fields.name: max_burn_bps
docs: Largest burn per side.

fields.name: max_rules_fee_bps
docs: Largest creator fee + holder fee + burn on one side.

fields.name: min_max_wallet_bps
docs: Smallest max wallet (when on).

fields.name: max_max_wallet_bps
docs: Largest max wallet.

fields.name: max_creator_lock_secs
docs: Longest creator wallet lock.

fields.name: max_early_window_secs
docs: Longest early-buyer window.

fields.name: max_early_lock_secs
docs: Latest early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch.
